definitions.endpoint: last_timeline_endpoint_samples from current native history; PRE publication endpoints from the isolated meter_history.json raw points
definitions.input_slot_supplied: Wall time immediately after supplying the final 10 ms block of each 100 ms input slot to both handles; not Measure Thread completion
definitions.first_endpoint_delay: First observation wall time minus that endpoint input_slot_supplied wall time; PRE file uses 2 ms observer, native poll uses nominal 10 Hz
definitions.latest_delta_input_slot_age: At each poll, wall time minus supplied time for latest returned delta endpoint; not raw measurement TTL age
definitions.nominal_audio_age: Wall time minus endpoint/sample_rate, relative to driver start; includes schedule phase and input block-start convention
definitions.cutoff_C_minus_E: Latest POST local native history endpoint minus latest delta native history endpoint at same poll batch, divided by sample rate; old independent APIs, not a new atomic packet proof
definitions.warmup: First-endpoint summaries exclude slots supplied before 0.6 s; latest-age and interval summaries exclude polls before 0.6 s

native_time_probe.compile_command_from_reference_checkout: clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=12.0 -I crates/kirin_hypha_ffi/include /tmp/hypha_g0_time_probe.cpp target/release/libkirin_hypha_ffi.a -framework Security -framework CoreFoundation -framework SystemConfiguration -o /tmp/hypha_g0_time_probe
limitations: The existing ABI exposes no original Measure Thread slot completion monotonic timestamp, so completion-based 400 ms TTL was not measured.
Native first observation occurs only on nominal 10 Hz poll ticks; it bounds discovery, not exact comparison publication wall time.
The observer and synthetic input feed share one driver loop. Observer processing and scheduler lateness are recorded; this is not actual DAW callback timing.
PRE meter_history.json publishes exact points; POST watch mtime is a publication cadence observation, not a per-cutoff exact delta publish time.
Source checkout, ABI sizes and library SHA match the stated probe inputs; exact library commit provenance is unconfirmed.
Two short single-pair development runs do not prove production maximum IO delay, all format/platform behavior, controlled raw-gap behavior, new atomic packet correctness, or fresh user acceptance.

C-E at or above 400 ms was observed. A strict C-E<400 ms policy would hide those ticks if applied to these returned endpoints; the probe does not establish whether each such tick is normal production pending or a genuine deadline failure.
Initial latest-only and regex observer trial runs were excluded because endpoint enumeration and instrumentation cost were improved before the two retained runs.
DRUM look-behind clock delay is a separate source and presentation concern; these TIME observations do not calibrate or validate L=150 ms.
